name: ledgerforge
description: The ledger for AI-native money movement. An open-source double-entry ledger for wallets, payouts, marketplaces and billing, with exact integer money, a verifiable audit chain, server-enforced spending limits and approvals for AI agents, and an MCP server. Apache 2.0.

analysis.summary_en: The system of record for fintech wallets, payouts, marketplaces and billing — with spending limits that keep AI agents in check and an audit trail you can prove.
highlights: Traceable releases: binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows, multi-platform
A hardened API: owner-bound key management, constrained delegation,
Deployment: secrets, TLS, limits and webhook verification
Security operations: API keys, delegation and rotation
